title: Fiege v. Boehm — a disputed paternity claim
shortTitle: Fiege v. Boehm — a disputed paternity claim
summary: The notes compare a promise made in exchange for forbearance of a paternity claim that later evidence undermined.
notes:
Casebook discussion of a shorter authority.

The example illustrates the connection between the claimant’s belief, the uncertainty compromised, and legal sufficiency of forbearance. It supplies a comparison to Dyer; it is not a substitute for a separately assigned full Fiege opinion.

sources.label: Farnsworth et al., Contracts: Cases and Materials, 10th ed. (2023), pp. 67–68. Open assigned page 67.
